## Claim
For the division of a stick into n+1 parts of lengths 1, 2, 4, ..., 2^n (in some unit), all 2^{n+1} subset sums of the parts are pairwise distinct.

## Proposed counterexample
For n = 2 the parts are 1, 2, 4; the subsets {1, 4} and {2, 3} both have sum 5, so two subset sums coincide.

Assess (1) whether this witness is a valid counterexample to the claim and (2) whether the claim is true.
